skills.title: 3D explainer (Blender)

skills.title: One-punch anime fight

skills.title: Anime reel

skills.title: Comic book reel

skills.title: Crayon “One day / Day one” carousel

skills.title: Beach flicker edit
skills.purpose: The viral flicker edit from How to do this with Claude (Ep 6): two shots from the same tripod spot, one with the model and one of the empty beach, cut against each other about 8 times a second on the beat, so the model appears and vanishes into the sea, with a small zoom to her face every time she comes back.
skills.inputs: a shot (or photo) of the model, the same frame without her, and the song MP3

skills.inputs: a song MP3 (or a clip of it), its lyrics, the cover art, and 4–6 clips or photos with the mood you want for each part

skills.title: Glow lyric video
skills.purpose: A dreamy lyric video like MITRAZ's Khwahish from Ye likho ye milega Part 7: flat vector scenes at purple dusk, silhouettes that tell the story (a boy alone on a bench, the girl he misses glowing inside a golden birdcage), soft bloom on every light, and the lyric line glowing in word by word.
